methodology.topology: one HTTP server worker process seeded once; load is driven over loopback HTTP
methodology.phases: fixed phase issues reads only; write phase adds paced POST /context writes (interval paces starts, responses awaited)
methodology.sampling: worker CPU/memory/counts/storage via IPC snapshot each sample tick; coordinator RSS and active handles recorded alongside
methodology.memory: RSS/heap from process.memoryUsage; sawtooth reflects GC, monotone trends need data-growth context
methodology.wal: wal_autocheckpoint(1000 pages) plus the 64MB/30s monitor bound the WAL; walBytes is the sampled file size
methodology.integrity: acknowledged write ids must be unique and match the final context row count; FTS marker checks cover all writes up to the 500-row query limit, else a sample
methodology.scope: single-machine observation; no thresholds or leak verdicts are derived from one run

analysis.gcNote: RSS/heap sawtooth reflects garbage collection and cache warm-up; sustained growth must be compared against databaseGrowthBytes and repeated runs before suspecting a leak
